sources.fullCitation: “Der neue Tauber-Film.” Das Kino-Journal (Vienna), 20 December 1930, p. 12. Österreichische Nationalbibliothek / ANNO.
sources.title: Der neue Tauber-Film
sources.researchNote: The production notice announces the forthcoming Richard Tauber sound film directed by Max Reichmann. It names Paul Dessau for musical direction, Fritz Rotter for the song texts and Dr. Kaper for the song music, and states that filming was to begin at Tempelhof on 2 January.

media.title: Das Kino-Journal, 20 December 1930 — announcement of the new Richard Tauber film
media.description: Das Kino-Journal, 20 December 1930, announcing the next Richard Tauber sound film for Emelka, directed by Max Reichmann, with Marianne Winkelstern, Margo Lion and Siegfried Arno: Paul Dessau leads the music, Fritz Rotter writes the song lyrics and “Dr. Kaper” the music of the hits; shooting to begin on 2 January at Tempelhof, with Tauber as a singing conductor. The film was released in 1931 as Die große Attraktion.
media.altText: Clipping headed “Der neue Tauber-Film” from Das Kino-Journal, 20 December 1930.
